messages:
Asha: Quick sync: gating noticed uneven bench coverage across languages and families. small models get lots of deep benches, large ones starved. we need a fairness policy.
Ravi: Noted. I suspect our current FIFO scheduler tilts towards quick-to-run jobs. deep benches for small models finish fast so they hog slots.
Katerina: Two levers: (1) budget-per-model windows (tokens) that replenish over time, (2) weighted scheduler where weight ~ model_importance + inverse_recent_runtime. both have tradeoffs.
Liam: We should also separate "safety" benches vs "perf" benches. Safety benches (golden prompts, regression checks) must be guaranteed a min share. Perf benches can be opportunistic.
Asha: Agreed. Proposed policy: every model gets a safety_quota (e.g., 1 safety bench per 6h) plus a shared opportunistic pool. safety_quota drains first; opportunistic consumes remaining capacity with FIFO+fairness.
Ravi: Implementation detail: intake should return a bench_ticket with fields: `ticket_id, lane: [safety|opportunistic], eta, cost_estimate`. That keeps decisioning deterministic for downstream schedulers.
Katerina: Also need a mechanism to rebalance when a model's safety_quota is not used (e.g., low-traffic private deploys). Allow short-lived loaning where unused safety tokens go to opportunistic pool for N hours. audit logs required.
Liam: For compatibility checks we should pin a small canonical prompt set (golden) per model and store expected hashes. bench result should emit `golden_hash` and `delta_score`. If delta > threshold -> immediate high-priority escalation lane.
Asha: I want an example API contract:
```
POST /intake/bench_request
{ model_id, requested_lane, seq_len_hint, customer_id }
-> { ticket_id, lane_assigned, scheduled_at, backpressure_flag }
```
Intake enforces quotas & signs `ticket_id` so worker can't fake lanes.
Ravi: Security note: signed tickets must be short TTL and verifyable with public key. Private deployments run their own signing key. Document in private-deploy checklist.
Katerina: Observability: add `model_bucket`, `lane`, `ticket_id` to bench traces. Also export per-model bench backlog and avg wait time to console. These metrics are helpful for SLO and product conversations.
Liam: Billing: bench_cost should be attributed to `customer_id` and optionally to `team_tag`. For Dedicated customers we surface bench usage on invoice and allow a bench_quota override in contract.
Asha: Edge case — meltdown mode: if runtime admission error > 2% and p95 latency doubles, we should suspend opportunistic benches for non-critical models and continue safety benches only. That prevents noisy neighbor issues.
Ravi: Could add a throttling policy using runtime_signal: `if cluster_signal == degraded -> set opportunistic_rate=0; grant emergency benches for models with emergency_flag=true`.
bench-bot: queued bench ticket TKT-171760-42 for model:gpt-small lane:safety eta:1717605800 :gear:
Katerina: Next steps: Ravi will prototype intake ticket flow + signing. Liam will add metrics to console. Asha will draft the fairness config defaults and escalation thresholds. I'll write the RFC follow-up with the API contract.
Asha: Thanks all — let's avoid another weekend of imbalance. :coffee:
